resolved_conflicts.explanation: The county list says Tower Gone, the NY chapter list says Dismantled and left at the site, and Wikipedia says left at the mountain top. Read together, the steel tower was taken down in 1989 and its remains were left on the summit. No source says what is there now.

notes_for_editor: The NY chapter alphabetical list (alphalist.html) is the main source: it gives the status line, the 'about 1920' construction with the unverifiable-date caveat, and the staffing lines. The Harriet Rega sentence sits in a sidebar on the Bald (Rondaxe) entry of the same page; the story cites it there. The list names the 1942 observer (Francis Boone); the story leaves her name out. Wikipedia and the list agree on the 1989 dismantling and on the remains being left on site. Coordinates: the record (43.98258, -74.84528) and Wikipedia (43.98312, -74.84463) differ by roughly 80 m by my estimate. The record's county, kind and status match the sources; no corrections. Nothing in the sources describes the summit today.
